envelope.note:
reused: testkit.world, testkit.run, testkit.fakes
Every scoped test now owns and closes a World; jobs fixtures are staged through World, files are planted through World, and every subprocess uses run with timeout=60. No scoped test requires a fake; no kit gap. Test names match the requested ref exactly. The 356-test task family is green and ruff is clean. Ratchet: home_by_hand 57 -> 18; embedded_programs 30 -> 11; run_without_timeout 185 -> 42; ratchet holds. No regression row was added because this is a behavior-preserving migration. An additional repository-wide suites run exposed a scoped fixture-copy import-order issue; it was fixed and all three reproducing fixture cases pass. That run also reported out-of-scope conductor failures, so no repository-wide-green claim is made. The implementation and session store were not read. Second producer absent. Red and green commit attempts for every module were denied because .git/index.lock is on a read-only filesystem; all six finished green files remain on disk.
